What if the biggest threat to India's future isn't a lack of talent—but a broken examination system?
In this video, Abhi and Niyu investigate the NEET paper leak controversy and uncover the deeper problems affecting India's education system. From paper leaks, cheating networks, coaching mafias, and weak enforcement to government accountability and practical reforms, we explore why millions of hardworking students continue to suffer despite repeated promises of change.
